insight: Built on JST-1, a foundation model the team describes as having an actual understanding of 3D physics and motion.
name: Viggle
tagline: Animate any character by mapping a motion video onto a still image.
description: Viggle is an AI video tool that brings still images to life — drop in a character photo and a motion reference clip, and it generates a video of that character performing the movement. It powers viral memes, VTubing, and previz, with web and mobile apps and a near real-time webcam-driven Live mode.

modelSupport.notes: Runs on Viggle's own JST-1 video foundation model.

edge: Specializes in controllable character motion — transfer a reference dance or action onto any image rather than prompt-to-clip generation.
pros: Maps reference motion onto any character
Web plus iOS and Android apps
cons: Narrow focus on character motion, not general video
Output quality varies with source images
Free tier subject to beta limits and queues
